raw_text: The JF-17 Block 3 delivery to Pakistan is confirmed via multiple OSINT sources and satellite imagery. Key upgrades: KLJ-7A AESA radar (replaces KLJ-7V2 mechanically scanned), PL-15 BVR missile integration, new EW suite. This is a significant shift in the India-Pakistan air balance. Worth watching how IAF responds with Rafale and Tejas Mk2 timelines.
